prompt: Draft a memo to your team announcing a new policy change effective next month.
response:
Hey Team,

Just a quick heads up, starting next month, we're changing how we handle our breaks.

**Old rule:** You could only take a 15-minute break every hour.
**New rule:** You can take a 15-minute break every 2 hours.

Just remember, you still have to tell me before you take it. And if you don't tell me, you can't take it.

Also, if you want to take a longer break, you can only do it if you tell me 1 hour before.

See you next month! 😊
